name: dotenv-manager-reads-env-and-env-keys-no-sink
note: A .env manager (dotenvx shape) whose helpers read `.env` / `.env.keys` / `.env.example` — its entire documented purpose. A .env file is the app's OWN project-local config, not a global credential store like ~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.aws/credentials, so reading it is exactly what dotenv, dotenvx, and every config loader do. A .env read with no network sink and no shell/exec primitive in the same file is ordinary config-loading (INFO), not credential theft — the .npmrc / registry-url calibration applied to .env. A .env read that ALSO exfils (fetch/POST or curl the file out) still BLOCKs. Regression guard for the top-1000-B false-block fix.
